name: handoff
description: Keeps the /handoff brief live: commits each edit, nudges when it goes stale, before the context fills and before the prompt cache expires, and carries it through compaction.

staleMinutes.title: Stale after (minutes)
staleMinutes.description: Nudge at the end of a turn when the brief is older than this and the repo has moved since.

contextPercent.title: Context threshold (%)
contextPercent.description: Ask for a brief update when the context window passes this fill, and every 15 points after.

idleMinutes.title: Idle before update (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: Ask for a brief update after this long idle, while the prompt cache is still warm. 0 turns it off.
